description: Webflow-flavoured MAX-WIDTH breakpoints, registered under the original's own names so every transcribed class string ports 1:1. These are NOT Tailwind's default min-width screens; both sets are available because they are added via `extend`.
note: The em engine freezes at 8.25833px for every viewport <=991px, so 768 and 390 share a root font-size and differ only by the max-wf-phone / max-wf-mini class overrides.
